title: psychotria peduncularis
intro: Psychotria peduncularis, commonly known as Maranha, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria peduncularis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing oxidative stress and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
